results.name: Finset.filter
results.source_text:
/-- `Finset.filter p s` is the set of elements of `s` that satisfy `p`.

For example, one can use `s.filter (· ∈ t)` to get the intersection of `s` with `t : Set α`
as a `Finset α` (when a `DecidablePred (· ∈ t)` instance is available). -/
def filter (s : Finset α) : Finset α :=
  ⟨_, s.2.filter p⟩

results.name: Finset.sum_filter_xor
results.source_text:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_filter_xor (p q : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred p] [DecidablePred q] :
    (∏ x ∈ s with (Xor (p x) (q x)), f x) =
      (∏ x ∈ s with (p x ∧ ¬ q x), f x) * (∏ x ∈ s with (q x ∧ ¬ p x), f x) := by

results.name: Finset.filter_sigma'
results.source_text:
lemma filter_sigma' (s : Finset ι) (t : ∀ i, Finset (α i)) (p : (i : ι) → α i → Prop)
    [∀ i, DecidablePred (p i)] :
    (s.sigma t).filter (fun x ↦ p x.fst x.snd) = s.sigma fun i ↦ (t i).filter (p i)  := by
  simp [filter_sigma]

results.name: Finset.filter_sigma
results.source_text:
lemma filter_sigma (s : Finset ι) (t : ∀ i, Finset (α i)) (p : (i : ι) × α i → Prop)
    [DecidablePred p] : (s.sigma t).filter p = s.sigma fun i ↦ (t i).filter fun x => p ⟨i, x⟩ := by
  ext ⟨i, a⟩
  simp [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_sigma, and_assoc]

results.name: Physlib.PiTensorProduct.instAddCommMonoidElim_physlib
results.source_text:
/-- Given two maps `s1` and `s2` whose targets carry an instance of an additive commutative
  monoid, the target of the sum of these two maps also carry an instance thereof. -/
instance : (i : ι1 ⊕ ι2) → AddCommMonoid ((fun i => Sum.elim s1 s2 i) i) := fun i =>
  match i with
  | Sum.inl i => inst1 i
  | Sum.inr i => inst2 i
results.docstring:
Given two maps `s1` and `s2` whose targets carry an instance of an additive commutative
